SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #6
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. pascal (Pa)
   B. watt (W)
   C. newton (N)
   D. joule (J)

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Sound Energy? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Sound Energy.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Sound Energy.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Sound Energy.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Sound Energy.

3. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Removing all vegetation
   B. Burning crop residue every week
   C. Overgrazing continuously
   D. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Mixtures 14 2.2. Water Pollution 18 3.0. Force and Energy 3.1. Floating and Sink? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Mixtures 14 2.2. Water Pollution 18 3.0. Force and Energy 3.1. Floating and Sink.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Mixtures 14 2.2. Water Pollution 18 3.0. Force and Energy 3.1. Floating and Sink.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Mixtures 14 2.2. Water Pollution 18 3.0. Force and Energy 3.1. Floating and Sink.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Mixtures 14 2.2. Water Pollution 18 3.0. Force and Energy 3.1. Floating and Sink.

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying The Human Breathing system 18 2.0. Matter 2.1. Mixtures 14 2.2. Water Pollution ? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to The Human Breathing system 18 2.0. Matter 2.1. Mixtures 14 2.2. Water Pollution .
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for The Human Breathing system 18 2.0. Matter 2.1. Mixtures 14 2.2. Water Pollution .
   C. Guess results without recording observations on The Human Breathing system 18 2.0. Matter 2.1. Mixtures 14 2.2. Water Pollution .
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about The Human Breathing system 18 2.0. Matter 2.1. Mixtures 14 2.2. Water Pollution .

6. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Heating until a solid melts
   B. Movement of water only across a membrane
   C. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   D. A chemical reaction forming ash

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying The Human Breathing System? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about The Human Breathing System.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to The Human Breathing System.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on The Human Breathing System.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for The Human Breathing System.

8. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   D. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Sound Energy 14 3.3. Heat transfer 12 Total number of lessons 120 NOTE: The sugg? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Sound Energy 14 3.3. Heat transfer 12 Total number of lessons 120 NOTE: The sugg.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Sound Energy 14 3.3. Heat transfer 12 Total number of lessons 120 NOTE: The sugg.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Sound Energy 14 3.3. Heat transfer 12 Total number of lessons 120 NOTE: The sugg.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Sound Energy 14 3.3. Heat transfer 12 Total number of lessons 120 NOTE: The sugg.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Classification of Plants? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Classification of Plants.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Classification of Plants.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Classification of Plants.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Classification of Plants.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Mixtures? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Mixtures.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Mixtures.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Mixtures.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Mixtures.

12. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any substance that conducts electricity
   B. A mixture of two liquids
   C. Any white crystal used in cooking
   D. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Floating and Sinking 14 3.2. Sound Energy 14 3.3. Heat transfer 12 Total number  and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Sound Energy 14 3.3. Heat transfer 12 Total number of lessons 120 NOTE: The sugg and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Sound Energy and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Heat transfer and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
